_about: Source upgrades + name merges applied by consolidate.py AFTER the research files are read (QC: Yelp-only records, 2026-10-17). 'add' appends credible [KEY,url] pairs a record lacks; 'merge' folds an alias record into its canonical one (sources unioned, alias dropped). Every URL was found by sequential WebSearch (researchedVia WebSearch 2026-10-17). Yelp/TripAdvisor stay as measurement only, never the recommender. Records with no credible recommender are held by the build's 0-credible gate and listed in AUDIT.md.
